decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a low-cost care accessory that rounds out the flooring system, and with the industry growing and the firm hiring, there is enough slack and no shortfall signal to prompt search.
The maintenance oil line fits the firm's surface-treatment positioning and ties customers to its oiled floors at modest resource cost, so its results likely meet aspiration.
Care products for oiled floors are routine companions to parquet sales that support customer relationships, and there is no evidence of underperformance.

Unlike the withdrawn high-density foam, the moisture-protection underlay serves a clear installer need within the floor system, though the underlay range remains under some review after Product E's removal.
The oak parquet line is at the heart of the firm's core business in a growing market, so withdrawing it is very unlikely.
